description: ODC (context: agent definition). The agent manifest (IAgentManifest) and its tools only exist in an AgentDefinition module: the platform creates the manifest with the module (create-blank --kind AgentDefinition) and it is born invalid until it has an AI model and instructions. The fixture brings offline connections for AI model, MCP and knowledge base (--connection), and the service action tool uses the producer app (blank-mobile-producer.oml), because an AgentDefinition does not create server actions ('Server Action can't be created in AgentDefinition runtime kind'). The event tool is in tests/jobs-coverage/f2-ctx/agent-definition-event-tool.json (an event referenced without a handler warns UnusedReferenceGlobalEvent, an ODC-only id that expectedMessages does not accept yet); the external library one is left out: its Action comes from an external library, which cannot be built offline.

ops._why: the manifest already exists: it is the platform that creates it with the module
